name: stream-machine
description: Hosted Twitch tools plus OBS and Stream Deck controls for your desktop.

interface.longDescription: Stream Machine Desktop installs two MCP servers on a desktop host. The hosted stream-machine server provides Twitch, clips, and the Stream Machine menu through the Stream Machine Site. The local stream-machine-desktop server provides 3 OBS tools and 4 USB Stream Deck tools. On web and mobile, install the Stream Machine Site plugin for Twitch instead. The package's other tools are disabled in source and not exposed.
defaultPrompt: Check OBS and my Stream Deck, then connect Twitch through the stream-machine server.
